title: on\'ona: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.10556v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce on\'ona, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate on\'ona across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, on\'ona lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B

translated_abstract: 权重绑定降低了语言模型的参数开销，但通常的绑定输出头仅限于单一的 softmax。我们提出了 on'ona，这是一种双表参数化方法，在保持输入-输出权重共享的同时提升了输出的表达能力。Transformer 将两个嵌入表的平均值作为输入，而输出头则组合由这两个相同的表所定义的 softmax 分布。一个仅取决于当前输入 token 的门控决定混合权重，其数值可以在推理时预先计算，且 Transformer 主体保持不变。我们在 142M、330M 和 1B 规模下，跨越稠密、Gated DeltaNet 混合、混合专家和注意力残差等架构对 on'ona 进行了评估。在匹配的 token 预算下，on'ona 在 12 项对比中的 11 项里降低了最终验证损失和外部困惑度，并在 10 项中提高了八个下游任务的平均准确率。损失方面的唯一例外是 1B
tldr: on'ona 提出了一种双嵌入表参数化方法，通过仅依赖当前输入 token 的门控来混合两个共享嵌入表定义的 softmax 分布，在保留权重绑定省参数优势的同时增强了输出头表达能力，在多种架构和三个规模下显著降低验证损失并提升下游任务准确率。
en_tdlr: on'ona introduces a two-table parameterization that mixes the softmax distributions defined by two tied embedding tables via a gate conditioned only on the current input token, boosting output expressiveness while preserving weight sharing and yielding lower validation loss and higher downstream accuracy across architectures and scales.
